assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a polished 2D hand-drawn seal rhythm game. The supplied seal image is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its scratchy navy colored-pencil outlines, creamy white highlights, icy blue watercolor, gentle paper-grain interiors. Create ONE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows, landscape, all 12 sprites isolated at the centers of their cells, with generous transparent gutters. True transparent background, no panel borders, no labels, no text, no checkerboard baked in. Row 1 left to right: (1) a joyful cream-gold and icy-blue hand-painted hit burst with irregular feathered sparkle strokes and foam curls, no geometric circle; (2) a generous fan-shaped ocean splash with many hand-drawn droplets; (3) an elegant curved watery swimming wake with tapering painted ribbons; (4) a soft fluffy white exhalation cloud with wind tendrils. Row 2: (5) a delicate breathing wreath made of irregular seafoam and tiny ice leaves, center completely empty, visually near-round but organic pencil art, no perfect circle; (6) a ragged icy fishing hole with an irregular snowy rim and deep blue water inside, seen slightly from above; (7) a cluster of differently shaped transparent watercolor bubbles with colored-pencil edges, organic not perfect circles; (8) long, soft underwater caustic light shafts and subtle wavy water highlights, painterly soft edges. Row 3: (9) a pair of delicate white feathered angel wings joined by a small golden hand-drawn halo, center transparent for a seal character; (10) one tiny friendly ice fisherman in a blue parka sitting with a fishing rod, full silhouette; (11) a little cluster of cream-gold ice-star twinkles, asymmetrical pencil strokes; (12) a horizontal strip of foamy watercolor ocean ripples and tiny glints. Consistent high-quality storybook game art, same palette and pencil finish as seal. Do not draw any seal. Transparent pixels everywhere outside the 12 cutout assets.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for the seal character in a 2D rhythm game. Use the supplied image as CHARACTER IDENTITY and ART STYLE reference. Generate one sheet exactly THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows, all SIX complete seal bodies at precisely identical scale, pose baseline and registration, each isolated in its cell with 12% transparent margin. True transparent background, no labels, no text, no drawn grid. Preserve this exact cute cream-white baby seal: dark navy pencil eyes and sketchy outlines, ice-blue watercolor shadows, tiny yellow highlights, no purple. Side view facing RIGHT, tail to LEFT, head to RIGHT, whole body visible. The body's position and size must remain consistent across frames, only the mouth/eyes/cheeks/flippers subtly change. Chronological frames left-to-right then next row: 1) swimming relaxed, mouth closed, happy eyes; 2) anticipatory open mouth, eyes interested, lower jaw open ready to bite; 3) wide-open joyful mouth, a tiny pale-blue fish halfway entering the mouth head-first from the right, visibly caught; 4) mouth closing, only the fish tail visible sticking out, cheeks puffy; 5) chewing with closed mouth, squinting happy eyes and round cheeks; 6) swallowed, very satisfied smile, cheeks relaxed. Clean anatomical continuity, recognizable exact same seal, polished pencil-and-watercolor picture-book game sprite finish. No motion lines outside the seal, no background scenery, no circles or UI.
